section.title: org.osgi.framework.hooks.service
section.para: Framework Service Hooks Package Version 1.1.
Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:

listitem.para: EventHook - OSGi Framework Service Event Hook Service.
EventListenerHook - OSGi Framework Service Event Listener Hook Service.
FindHook - OSGi Framework Service Find Hook Service.
ListenerHook - OSGi Framework Service Listener Hook Service.
ListenerHook.ListenerInfo - Information about a Service Listener.

section.title: public interface EventHook
section.para: OSGi Framework Service Event Hook Service.
Bundles registering this service will be called during framework service (register, modify, and unregister service) operations.

formalpara.title: Deprecated
formalpara.para: As of 1.1. Replaced by EventListenerHook.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

section.title: public void event(ServiceEvent event, Collection<BundleContext> contexts)

formalpara.title: event
formalpara.para: The service event to be delivered.

formalpara.title: contexts
formalpara.para: A collection of Bundle Contexts for bundles which have listeners to which the specified event will be delivered. The implementation of this method may remove bundle contexts from the collection to prevent the event from being delivered to the associated bundles. The collection supports all the optional Collection operations except add and addAll. Attempting to add to the collection will result in an UnsupportedOperationException. The collection is not synchronized.

section.para: Event hook method. This method is called prior to service event delivery when a publishing bundle registers, modifies or unregisters a service. This method can filter the bundles which receive the event.

section.title: public interface EventListenerHook
section.para: OSGi Framework Service Event Listener Hook Service.
Bundles registering this service will be called during framework service (register, modify, and unregister service) operations.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

section.title: public void event(ServiceEvent event, Map<BundleContext, Collection<ListenerHook.ListenerInfo>> listeners)

formalpara.title: event
formalpara.para: The service event to be delivered.

formalpara.title: listeners
formalpara.para: A map of Bundle Contexts to a collection of Listener Infos for the bundle's listeners to which the specified event will be delivered. The implementation of this method may remove bundle contexts from the map and listener infos from the collection values to prevent the event from being delivered to the associated listeners. The map supports all the optional Map operations except put and putAll. Attempting to add to the map will result in an UnsupportedOperationException. The collection values in the map supports all the optional Collection operations except add and addAll. Attempting to add to a collection will result in an UnsupportedOperationException . The map and the collections are not synchronized.

section.para: Event listener hook method. This method is called prior to service event delivery when a publishing bundle registers, modifies or unregisters a service. This method can filter the listeners which receive the event.

section.title: public interface FindHook
section.para: OSGi Framework Service Find Hook Service.
Bundles registering this service will be called during framework service find (get service references) operations.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

section.title: public void find(BundleContext context, String name, String filter, boolean allServices, Collection<ServiceReference<?>> references)

formalpara.title: context
formalpara.para: The bundle context of the bundle performing the find operation.

formalpara.title: name
formalpara.para: The class name of the services to find or null to find all services.

formalpara.title: filter
formalpara.para: The filter criteria of the services to find or null for no filter criteria.

formalpara.title: allServices
formalpara.para: true if the find operation is the result of a call to BundleContext.getAllServiceReferences(String, String)

formalpara.title: references
formalpara.para: A collection of Service References to be returned as a result of the find operation. The implementation of this method may remove service references from the collection to prevent the references from being returned to the bundle performing the find operation. The collection supports all the optional Collection operations except add and addAll. Attempting to add to the collection will result in an UnsupportedOperationException. The collection is not synchronized.

section.title: public interface ListenerHook
section.para: OSGi Framework Service Listener Hook Service.
Bundles registering this service will be called during service listener addition and removal.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

section.title: public void added(Collection<ListenerHook.ListenerInfo> listeners)

formalpara.title: listeners
formalpara.para: A collection of ListenerInfos for newly added service listeners which are now listening to service events. Attempting to add to or remove from the collection will result in an UnsupportedOperationException. The collection is not synchronized.

section.para: Added listeners hook method. This method is called to provide the hook implementation with information on newly added service listeners. This method will be called as service listeners are added while this hook is registered. Also, immediately after registration of this hook, this method will be called to provide the current collection of service listeners which had been added prior to the hook being registered.

section.title: public void removed(Collection<ListenerHook.ListenerInfo> listeners)

formalpara.title: listeners
formalpara.para: A collection of ListenerInfos for newly removed service listeners which are no longer listening to service events. Attempting to add to or remove from the collection will result in an UnsupportedOperationException. The collection is not synchronized.

section.para: Removed listeners hook method. This method is called to provide the hook implementation with information on newly removed service listeners. This method will be called as service listeners are removed while this hook is registered.

section.title: public static interface ListenerHook.ListenerInfo
section.para: Information about a Service Listener. This interface describes the bundle which added the Service Listener and the filter with which it was added.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

formalpara.title: Provider Type
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this type

section.title: public boolean equals(Object obj)

formalpara.title: obj
formalpara.para: The object to compare against this ListenerInfo.

section.para: Compares this ListenerInfo to another ListenerInfo. Two ListenerInfos are equals if they refer to the same listener for a given addition and removal life cycle. If the same listener is added again, it must have a different ListenerInfo which is not equal to this ListenerInfo.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: true if the other object is a ListenerInfo object and both objects refer to the same listener for a given addition and removal life cycle.

section.title: public BundleContext getBundleContext()
section.para: Return the context of the bundle which added the listener.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The context of the bundle which added the listener.

section.title: public String getFilter()
section.para: Return the filter string with which the listener was added.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The filter string with which the listener was added. This may be null if the listener was added without a filter.

section.title: public int hashCode()
section.para: Returns the hash code for this ListenerInfo.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The hash code of this ListenerInfo.

section.title: public boolean isRemoved()
section.para: Return the state of the listener for this addition and removal life cycle. Initially this method will return false indicating the listener has been added but has not been removed. After the listener has been removed, this method must always return true.

There is an extremely rare case in which removed notification to ListenerHooks can be made before added notification if two threads are racing to add and remove the same service listener. Because ListenerHooks are called synchronously during service listener addition and removal, the Framework cannot guarantee in-order delivery of added and removed notification for a given service listener. This method can be used to detect this rare occurrence.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: false if the listener has not been removed, true otherwise.
